existing_session_cache.conclusion: Existing same-owner facts, finance and identical reference keys are cached. Different targets with shared predecessors still rescan declarations; context-specific correctness must be retained.

findings.root_cause: Per-page comprehension scans document-wide page/lane keys; P pages with one lane incur P squared work and zero relations.
findings.fix: Build page-to-lanes index once, charge actual index creation and actual local visits.

findings.root_cause: All same-parent DOM pairs reserved and inspected before necessary language difference check; all same-family units still n(n-1)/2.
findings.fix: Reuse observed language families before enumeration; preserve original structural alignment, pair ordering and exact relation output.

findings.root_cause: Reserve full left*right cardinality even if all observed language families make pairs impossible.
findings.fix: Exclude provably impossible family buckets before nearest matching; retain mixed/missing language conservative behavior, original tie ordering and geometry semantics.

findings.root_cause: 32 full grammar scans per gated clause, then20 business recognizer logical passes per new source owner. Same owner fact and financial projection are already cached.
findings.fix: If further optimization is needed, derive conservative event-family dispatch from existing grammar and reuse immutable normalized lexical observations; unsupported pattern must fallback to full grammar, never false absence.

findings.root_cause: Same target/predecessor key cached; different targets sharing predecessor rescan immutable declaration observations.
findings.fix: Optional session-local declaration observation cache by original source unit ID; retain target-specific compatibility, window completeness, nearest family, competing-family ambiguity and original offsets.

findings.root_cause: Reference, qualifications and local-context passes precede source-priority candidate loop. IPO exhausts in preflight before first final candidate.
findings.fix: First remove proven unnecessary work. If still needed, process source-proven closed dependency scopes incrementally; never publish a fact before its qualifier/reference envelope is closed.

recommended_reds: Doubling one-lane page count must remain near linear with zero spurious relations.
Same-language DOM siblings and unequal lane populations must not pay pairwise work; preserve mixed-language exact original relations and ordering.
Two legitimate mixed-language counterpart pairs on multiple sources/pages must remain separated and preserve confidence and refs.

Cached repeated fact, finance and identical reference calls pay zero additional semantic work. Shared predecessor observations may be reused but target-specific ambiguity/negative restriction stays unchanged.
Known complete independent business package survives later tail exhaustion as partial; unknown qualification tail in same dependency scope may never yield naked plan or completion.
After a meaningful source-owner change only, replay frozen IPO with the same parse+select16M ledger and112 cap; no gold means NOT_GRADED, not semantic PASS.

boundaries.temporary_directory_restore: No temporary directories created; only assigned diagnostic/report files written.

errors_and_corrections: Initial neutral parser_version was cf3-1, invalid for emitted EvidenceSpan. Preserved invalid-fixture diagnostics; corrected to1.0.0. Corrected full measurements are identical in all logical work/outcome fields.
One literal rg path wildcard was invalid on Windows; switched to concrete file paths.
Broad historical JSON literal search yielded oversized single lines; switched to filename-only Python search and bounded reads. No source copies or mutations.
limitations: Do not assign synthetic work proportions to the real IPO.
Frozen profile records direct charge sites only; it does not identify reserve secondary callers. No real14k unchanged replay was performed.
Logical work accounting is not instruction count, timing or API cost.
Neutral PDF0 spans is not a recall claim; the suite is a complexity probe without semantic gold.
Existing late completed-candidate preservation is a positive control, not a newly discovered defect.
